title: Test distributed predictive coding across the SOL field
description: Add an optional parameter-neutral auxiliary next-character objective at every SOL cell using the existing token embedding as a tied local readout. Keep designated output cells as the only emitted inference organ. The auxiliary signal must preserve continuous stream state, delayed reward, parameter count, checkpoint compatibility, and exact BPTT while giving sparse internal cells direct event-specific predictive error. Run a matched reduced-scale gain sweep before any full GPU claim.
notes: First tied-readout sweep (16x16, 800 updates, no metabolism/reward) is seed-sensitive and negative overall. Gain 0.03 final deltas vs matched control: seed7 -0.094 BPC (better), seed13 +0.090 worse, seed21 +0.142 worse; mean +0.046 worse. Gains 0.1 and 0.3 also hurt seed7. Diagnosis: auxiliary classifier gradients write directly into the same embedding used as sensory input, likely conflicting with the input codebook. Next test detaches the embedding only on the decoder side, preserving all-cell/axon backward credit while keeping sensory embedding learning on its ordinary input path.
close_reason: Falsified after matched three-seed sweeps. Fully tied all-cell prediction was capability-negative and seed-sensitive. Detached body-only prediction improved reward-disabled final BPC by 0.03593 mean, but with SOL delayed reward active its mean final benefit collapsed to 0.00153 BPC, mean best was 0.00809 worse, and two of three seeds regressed. Experimental code removed; results documented in S7.

title: Align SOL axon acceptance with organism-level predictive fitness
description: Preserve continuous exploratory probes and conservative multi-window confirmation, but add a direct organism-level prediction signal to structural acceptance. The criterion must reject candidates that are locally credited yet worsen global prequential language loss, without freezing ordinary weights, recurrent state, reward, or exploratory traffic. Compare against the same living probes-only control and S3.
notes: Full matched 64x64 seed7 GPU result: stable/full reachability, but global sign gate rejected zero cycles and installed 15/15, same as S3. Capability decisively worse: all-eval mean +0.01910 BPC, second-half +0.02936, final-six +0.03048; wins 5/20, 1/11 second half, 1/6 late. Final growth 2.60450 vs control 2.50610. Anatomy functional (final birth penalty +0.02565; late-six +0.03400) but organism worse. First-order sign is measurable telemetry, not a reliable acceptance criterion. Documented; no promotion.
close_reason: Implemented and tested organism-level gradient fitness. Zero-margin sign gating is non-selective at 64 targets and worsens capability versus both control and S3.

title: Propagate SOL reward backward through directed axons
description: Replace or augment globally broadcast whole-cell reward with a persistent output-originating credit wave that travels against the signed directed axons. Pending surprise reward should enter output cells, propagate locally toward source cells, meet event eligibility, persist across optimizer boundaries, and remain checkpointable. Preserve one-shot fast-synapse reward, parameter count, continuous stream state, and old checkpoints. Gate on causal reverse direction, event specificity, no-reward invariance, exact resume, and matched CPU capability before GPU.
notes: Implemented parameter-neutral persistent backward_credit (B,N) in FieldState. Pending reward injects once at outputs; signed forward coefficients scatter target credit to named sources; bounded decay carries it across tokens/windows; local eligibility gates its effect. Direct and reverse gains are separate; fast reward remains one-shot. Old checkpoints add zeros; evaluation shuffle/metrics and local bridge telemetry updated. Full suite 57 passed, compileall/diff check clean. Reduced 16x16 3-seed: reverse-only gain0.25 mean best/final improvements 0.00227/0.00859 but all-eval mean 0.00490 worse. Direct+reverse0.25 mean improvements: best 0.00673, final 0.04284, all-eval 0.00520; seed21 final regressed 0.06032, so preliminary not conclusive. Gain0.1 weaker and all-eval negative. Queue full matched GPU run after CUDA restoration; no promotion.

title: Add reversible post-graft probation for SOL axons
description: Keep the incumbent source recoverable after a confirmed graft. Let the entire continuously stimulated organism co-adapt for a bounded probation period under ordinary traffic, reward, and backprop; measure observed prequential fitness, then retain or roll back the anatomical change. Preserve optimizer/state integrity and use a matched living control. This directly tests body-with-organ developmental response instead of another pre-graft proxy.
design: Use one checkpointable active probation at a time. A confirmed candidate is installed provisionally while the incumbent source, edge parameters, optimizer moments, structural credit/age, and stream-local edge eligibility/fast efficacy are backed up exactly. The full organism then trains continuously for a bounded update budget while mean signed prequential reward is accumulated. At resolution, positive observed advantage commits the graft; otherwise every backed-up value is restored. New graft decisions pause during probation but exploratory probe traffic continues. Probes-only runs the same cadence as a virtual probation without topology mutation.
notes: Implemented exact reversible probation with checkpointed source/parameter/optimizer/credit/age/stream-local slot backup. Failed graft restores slot exactly while unrelated body learning and spent energy remain. Positive commits; probes-only virtual cadence. Active resume exact. Added pre-graft developmental reward EMA because raw reward committed ordinary learning; probation now scores improvement over the body's own trend. Full suite 47 passed. Natural 16x16 smoke (550 updates): growing 3 attempts, 0 commits, 3 rollbacks, no active trial, final topology exactly birth, 3.99063 BPC; virtual control 3 trials, 3.99328. Last improvement -0.00674 vs control -0.00624. Ready for full GPU.
close_reason: Implemented and deterministically validated exact reversible post-graft probation in commit 70c51ad; superseded as the primary experiment by within-organism exploratory traffic per user direction.

title: Measure SOL grafts with interleaved exploratory traffic
description: Test each confirmed axon candidate inside one continuously learning organism by alternating candidate-probe-on and candidate-probe-off streamed windows while all other probes, reward flow, hidden state, body parameters, and backprop remain live. Commit only from within-organism reward advantage; do not use a frozen-topology organism as the primary decision signal.
notes:
Implemented within-organism exploratory probation. The incumbent topology remains installed while only the selected target probe follows a balanced ABBA on/off schedule; every other probe remains live and shared hidden/body/optimizer/energy state learns continuously in both arms. Candidate and incumbent rewards are checkpointed separately; commit requires positive within-organism advantage plus endpoint energy at the actual decision boundary. Rejection spends no energy and mutates no anatomy. Added CLI/telemetry/docs and exact resume coverage. Full suite 53 passed (4 pre-existing warnings), compileall and diff check pass. Natural 16x16 Tiny Shakespeare CPU smoke, 400 updates: 2 completed trials, both 20-on/20-off, 2 commits, advantages +0.04057 and +0.03349, no active trial, best/final BPC 4.36290/4.42543. Mechanism only, not a capability claim. Full GPU run blocked by remote driver state after the 2070S disappeared and poisoned new CUDA initialization on the otherwise visible 4090.
Added a checkpointed per-trial ledger and decision-aligned whole-body survival analysis. Every real exploratory trial now records candidate identity, ABBA reward means, decision advantage/outcome/update, and body/endpoint energy before/after; benchmark aligns held-out BPC before and after each intervention until the next trial and marks missing follow-up pending. Fresh 16x16/400-update Tiny Shakespeare smoke: 3 trials, 2 rejected (-0.05386, -0.02793), 1 committed (+0.00571), 2 evaluable trials both survived, 1 pending due no isolated eval; accepted trial improved held-out BPC 4.74495 -> 4.55362 -> 4.32248 while exact growth energy was charged. Full suite 58 passed (4 pre-existing warnings). Full GPU capability test still pending CUDA recovery.
Three-seed matched CPU preflight complete. Seed7: 3 trials/1 commit/2 reject/2 survived/1 pending/final 4.32248. Seed13: 4/3/1/4 survived/0 pending/final 4.20667. Seed21: 1/0/1/1 survived/final 4.35458. Aggregate: 8 trials, exactly 4 positive committed and 4 negative rejected; mean advantage +0.00200, median -0.00257, range -0.05386..+0.10234; all 7 evaluable trials survived and each run's best BPC was final. Full GPU protocol now assigns seed7 then21 to 4090 and seed13 concurrently to 2070S—three living exploratory organisms, not a frozen-topology primary arm. 64x64, 5000 updates, confirmation3, trial300, eval/checkpoint250, no fast efficacy/no ordinary metabolic drain; frozen probes-only is secondary context only after the within-organism gate.

title: Benchmark SOL on Tiny Shakespeare with recurrent controls
description: Add checkpoint/resume and train/validation evaluation for a real character corpus. Compare persistent state, shuffled/reset-state ablations, fixed-edge null policies, and a parameter-matched GRU baseline. Report held-out loss, generation samples, cell/edge credit, energy, and reachability.
notes: S0 controls complete: no-metabolism best/final 2.451/2.535; lr1e3 2.523/2.559; no-reward 2.492/2.624; default reward best/final 2.484/2.562. Current cell reward yields only 0.008 best-BPC benefit and worse final stability. Fast-memory experiments active on both GPUs.
close_reason: Completed matched Tiny Shakespeare benchmark, recurrent/transformer controls, fixed-edge, no-metabolism, lower-LR, no-reward, state ablations, topology, warmup sweep, guarded report, checkpoint promotion, and local live bridge.

title: Add reward-modulated fast synaptic memory to SOL
description: After the S0 reward ablation completes, extend FieldState with bounded per-edge eligibility and fast plasticity. Local pre/post activity should tag directed dendrites; delayed scalar reward should change only tagged fast synaptic efficacy across truncation boundaries while exact BPTT remains the slow weight learner. Checkpoint/resume must preserve the state. Tests must prove delayed specificity, no-reward invariance, boundedness, gradient flow, and no energy minting. This is a prerequisite for credit-driven axon growth rather than random rewiring.
notes: Full-scale seed7 is statistically unresolved: fast best 2.4392529 versus matched no-fast 2.4418460 (0.0025931 BPC, about 0.1%, best-of-20 on 2048 scored chars), while fast final is 0.0168705 BPC worse. Best-checkpoint zero-fast penalty is +0.0027449, showing small causal use but not a replicated net capability gain. Seed13 full pair launched on 4090/2070S as PIDs 1459378/1459379; seed21 will follow. Do not declare S1 passed from seed7 alone.
close_reason: Closed as a stable but capability-neutral negative result: the full-scale fast best beat matched no-fast by only 0.00259 BPC (about 0.1%, best-of-20), finished 0.01687 BPC worse, and did not justify more replication.

title: Make SOL energy govern viability and distributed metabolism
description: Extend sol/ so externally earned energy propagates through the directed connectome, pays cell and axon costs, gates computation, and can cause reversible quiescence or death. Add conservation/provenance tests so recurrent self-excitation cannot mint stimulation or energy.
notes:
Started implementation while GPU service awaits authorized recovery. First scope: audit current energy/stimulation path, specify conservation and provenance invariants, then add parameter-neutral directed energy sharing and reversible quiescence with exact checkpoint/evaluation/UI telemetry. Death will not be made irreversible until recovery behavior and language stability are measured.
Implemented S9 conserved directed metabolism and reversible viability. Novel character input is the sole inflow; named dendrite plus probe flow redistributes source-owned energy with per-source demand and per-target capacity normalization, conserving total transport exactly. Basal/activity/growth are sinks. Parameter-free viability gates cell update, emission, eligibility, and output; full basal maintenance makes silence reach finite quiescence; new sensory/incoming energy recovers cells. Added CLI knobs and train/eval/local-bridge provenance telemetry. Selected calibration: external gain .05, transport .50, quiescence .01, full activity .05. Matched 16x16/400-update/no-fast CPU results vs exact energy-one control: seed7 4.11596 vs 4.19911 (-.08315), seed13 4.33256 vs 4.43384 (-.10128), seed21 4.29217 vs 4.40613 (-.11396). Candidate won 17/24 evals; mean endpoint -.09946, all-eval -.07422. Final mean energy .97997, viability1, q0, input .08092, spend .07696, transport drift -3.5e-8. Full suite 63 passed with 4 pre-existing warnings. Short-budget replicated win only; 64x64/5000 GPU validation pending CUDA recovery.

title: Require persistent evidence before SOL axon consolidation
description: Keep structural probes continuously active in both arms, but hold candidates across multiple structural phases and require repeated positive credit evidence before installing them. Compare against an identically stimulated probes-only control and the S2 permissive consolidation run. Gate on rewrite selectivity, paired late-run BPC, birth-topology ablation, stability, and reachability.
notes: Matched 64x64 seed7 GPU run complete with living probes-only control. Three-phase growth installed 15 rewrites vs S2 46; stable and fully reachable. Mechanism improved but capability gate failed: overall mean +0.00913 BPC worse, second-half +0.00962, final-six +0.00309; wins 9/20, 6/11 second half, 4/6 late. Best growth 2.44067 vs control 2.46168 but final growth 2.55800 vs control 2.50610. Final birth-topology penalty +0.04642 and late-six mean +0.04099. Update2500 directly exposed harmful confirmed anatomy (growth 2.70393, birth 2.66200, control 2.66173), later co-adapted positive. Documented; no promotion.
close_reason: Implemented and tested persistent confirmation. It substantially reduces rewrites and improves S2 aggregates, but still loses paired second-half and late mean BPC; local credit remains globally misaligned.

title: Restore remote CUDA service after RTX 2070S fault
description: The RTX 2070 Super at PCI 04:00.0 disappeared from NVIDIA driver 595.71.05 with an unknown device-handle error. It killed the S5 jobs and new PyTorch CUDA initialization fails even when selecting the healthy RTX 4090 by UUID. Restore CUDA service (likely device reset, driver restart, or host reboot), verify a PyTorch matrix operation on the 4090, then run S6 exploratory-traffic training. Preserve failed run logs for diagnosis.
notes: Read-only diagnosis: both devices remain bound to nvidia 595.71.05; 2070S at 04:00.0 is present in PCI/proc but NVML device-handle creation fails and kernel continuously reports _issueRpcLarge status 0x0f assertions. 4090 at 08:00.0 remains visible and services existing display/compute clients, but a fresh PyTorch context selected by exact 4090 UUID still returns CUDA device_count=0/unknown error. Desktop and nvtop hold /dev/nvidia0, so an isolated device reset or module reload would disrupt active user processes and was not attempted without authorization. Driver restart or host reboot remains the safe recovery boundary.

description: Create sol/ as an independent experimental package for a persistent character-level neural field. The prototype must use sparse directed axon/dendrite communication rather than convolutional neighborhoods, preserve state across streamed characters, train with continuous truncated BPTT, expose delayed-credit/eligibility memory, model energy from novel stimulation, and demonstrate next-character learning with tests and companion documentation.

Verification: sol tests 7/7; full repo 17/17; 120-update CPU smoke loss 3.5735 -> 0.6646, perplexity 35.64 -> 1.94 with nonzero cell and edge credit. title: Grow and prune SOL axons from local activity and credit
description: After fixed-topology transport is stable, add structural phases between differentiable windows. Targets should accumulate candidate source IDs from measured causal traffic, grow bounded directed dendrites when endpoints can pay, and prune old low-credit edges. Preserve optimizer and persistent-state integrity across topology changes.
notes: Full exploratory-traffic GPU comparison complete (64x64, seed 7, 5k updates). Both arms continuously rotated identical non-edge probes and trained all ordinary weights/state; control froze only permanent source installation. Growth made 46/46 possible rewrites, remained fully reachable/stable. Mechanistic success: final learned-topology BPC 2.539 vs birth-topology 2.801 (+0.262); late-six mean ablation +0.260. Capability gate failed: best 2.512 vs control 2.471; all-eval mean growth worse +0.0128 BPC, second-half +0.0203, late-six +0.0136; growth won 8/20 paired checkpoints. Diagnosis: every eligible phase rewired, so current margin is non-selective. Documented in s2-structural-plasticity.md; no live promotion.
close_reason: Implemented and validated causal axon growth with living exploratory control. Anatomy is functional but the first consolidation rule is capability-negative on aggregate; follow-up will add multi-window evidence persistence.
